			aub_can_upgrade_to_mining_office_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = mining_office_01
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = mining_office_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = mining_office_02
			aub_can_upgrade_to_mining_office_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = mining_office_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = mining_office_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = mining_office_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_mining_office_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = mining_office_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = mining_office_04 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = mining_office_04
			aub_can_upgrade_to_mining_office_05_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = mining_office_04
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = mining_office_05 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
}
